name: app-blue-charts-and-hotel-booking-phone-hand-collage
title: Bars, Sky Phone and Hotel Booking Hand
whatItIs: A lavender collage: a blue bar chart with faded tracks, a tilted phone against a sky, and a large tile with ghost 'Hotel Booking' lettering, a hand-held phone and floating cards for villa, facilities and description.
whatItMeans: Tiles mix data, atmosphere and product, and the floating cards explain the screen without clutter.
techniques: Ghost lettering behind a held phone
Floating info cards around the device
Sky photograph as a tile background
Faded track bars in the chart
Blue facilities panel with icon tiles

vocabulary.definition: A UI card placed outside the device to explain it.
Rounded tiles of different content arranged together.
A faint bar showing the maximum behind a value.
